run_pipeline_video_classification: run the VideoClassificationPipeline to assign labels to a single video or batch of videos from local paths or HTTP URLs
build_pipeline_video_classification: build a VideoClassificationPipeline instance with a model for video classification using PyAV and an image processor
test_preprocess_video_classification: test the VideoClassificationPipeline preprocess method that samples frames from a video and prepares model inputs
review_postprocess_video_classification: review the VideoClassificationPipeline postprocess method that applies softmax or sigmoid and returns top-k labeled scores
summarize_read_video_pyav: summarize the read_video_pyav helper function that extracts specific frames from a PyAV container into an RGB numpy array
